scope: Historical JSON is inspected, not reproduced. All original external fulltexts remain outside Git.

frozen_C_metrics.temperature_selection: equal-family, equal-three-types NLL; ties closest to1 then smallerT
frozen_C_metrics.policy_selection: maximum coverage with positive accepts and empirical accepted error<=0.05, ties higher threshold; no feasible policy means all handoff
frozen_C_metrics.accepted_rule: calibrated p_max>=tau AND chosen ID != none AND same-entity choice_info prediction=yes
frozen_C_metrics.accepted_error: choice wrong OR world unsupported OR gold required information insufficient
frozen_C_metrics.scope: single project-authored rule-world generator; held-out state wording template is not independent corpus/pretraining-unseen evidence

v2_historical_result.scope: Frozen from-zero finite multimodal candidates. Tests are not reused for selection or training; unchanged original criteria remain unmet.

data_scope.recording_unit: recordings, not people; speaker IDs unknown; no speaker-disjoint claim
data_scope.ocr_fonts: Sans and Serif both seen in training; historical condition unseen_font labels do not imply an unseen font
data_scope.ocr_region_source: one caller-provided contiguous 1–4-cell ROI; no text detection model

v2_historical_result.comparison_limit: Descriptive final artifacts with different joint objectives and selected histories. Top-2 MoE has two FFNs against Dense one; not a controlled architecture, FLOP or memory comparison.
